summary: The Form 8-K filed by American Water Works Company, Inc. reports subsidiary rate-case settlements with utility regulators. California-American Water filed a partial settlement with the CPUC on a general rate case, proposing incremental annualized revenues of $24M (2027), $21M (2028), $22M (2029), versus its original $43M request. Virginia-American Water filed a black-box stipulation for a $16M annualized increase, below its $22M request. These are routine regulatory proceedings, not special-situations events.
